items.prompt: Write 2–3 sentences about your daily routine.
items.answer: I usually wake up early and drink coffee. Then I work on my laptop and take a short walk after lunch.

items.prompt: Imagine you are introducing yourself to a new classmate. What do you say?
items.answer: Hi, my name is Alex. I am learning English because I want to travel and meet people from other countries.

items.prompt: A notice says the library closes at 6pm on Fridays. In one sentence, explain what that means for a student who arrives at 6:10pm.
items.answer: The student cannot enter because the library is already closed at that time.

items.prompt: Complete: Yesterday I ___ to the market and ___ some fruit.
items.answer: Yesterday I went to the market and bought some fruit.
